title: Async stream pipeline
prompt: Implement `static async IAsyncEnumerable<int> MultiplyAsync(IAsyncEnumerable<int> source, int factor)` yielding each element times factor, and `static async Task<List<int>> Collect(IAsyncEnumerable<int> source)` materializing a stream to a list. Build the source with an async iterator that yields 1,2,3 with `await Task.Yield()` between items.

tests.name: pipeline
tests.hint: await foreach (var item in source.ConfigureAwait(false)) — multiply and yield return.
